iosInstallNotice.installedCopy: Have a wallet in Safari? It is not shared with this installed copy — restore it here from its recovery phrase.
iosInstallNotice.beforeInstall: Installing to your Home Screen starts a separate, empty copy — back up your recovery phrase first, then restore it in the installed app.

connectionButton.introMobile: Your keys stay on this device. Choose how it connects.

connectionButton.torDescMobile: Hides your IP. The daemon still sees your transactions. Needs Orbot.
connectionButton.addOwnDesc: A wallet daemon you run yourself.
connectionButton.notPairingCode: That code is not a wallet-service pairing code. On the computer serving the wallet, open Host → Network access → Pair a phone.
